spans.s: + ईश रोहिणी- + ईश, m. the moon.

रोह, i. e. रुह् + अ, m.
 1. A bud.
 2. Mounting,
Rājat. 5, 15

रोहक, i. e. रुह् + अक,
 I. adj. Riding, mounted on any vehicle.
 II. m. A sort of goblin.

रोहण, i. e. रुह् + अन,
 I. m. A mountain, Adam's peak in Ceylon, Pañc. MS. Berol., cf. Wilson in Trans. of the R.A.S. i. 169.
 II. n.
 1.

Growing.
 2

Mountaing.
 3
. Semen virile.

रोहिण, i. e. रुह् + इन् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. The Indian fig-tree.
 2. A fragrant grass.
 II. n. A part of the forenoon. See रोहित.

रोहित्, probably akin to रुधिर, ह् for ध्,
 I. m. The sun.
 II. f. The female of the black antelope.

रोहित, akin to रुधिर, ह् for ध्,
 I. adj., f. ता and इणी.
 1.

Red.
 2
. Coloured,

.
 II. m.
 1. Red, the colour.
 2. A (kind of) deer, Utt.
. A fish, Cyprinas rohita,

.
 III. f. इणी, also रोहिणि रोहिणि.
 1. The fourth lunar asterism,
Vikr. 38, 12

(णी).
 2. The mother of बल-राम.
 IV. f. इणी.
 1.

Lightning.
 2

. A girl at the commencement of the menstruation, Pañc. iii. d. 213.
 3. A woman stained with red pigments.
 4. Inflammatory affection of the throat.
 5. A cow.
 6. Yellow myrobalan.
 7. Bengal madder.
 V. n.
 1.

Blood.
 2

Safflower.
 3
. The rainbow appearing in a straight form.

रोहिन्,
 I. रुह् + इन्, m.
 1. The Indian fig-tree.
 2. The holy figtree.
 II. (cf. रोकित्.) A stag,
(but perhaps is to be read रोहिन्-मांसम्, i. e. रोहित्-).
